label: prf:q-beta-over-e0-classical-vanishing
title: Proof of q beta over e0 classical vanishing
html:
Proof

Direct evaluation:

S(1) \;=\; \frac{(2\cdot 1 + 1 - 1)\,(1 - 1)}{2\cdot 1}
\;=\; \frac{2 \cdot 0}{2} \;=\; 0. \qquad\blacksquare

The substantive content is the algebraic structure of the numerator: \mathfrak{Q}_\beta carries a (q+1) factor, E_0^{(N=0)} carries a 1/[q(q-1)] pole, and their product picks up the (q^2 - 1) = (q+1)(q-1) in the simplified form — so the ratio inherits a (q-1) zero at q = 1 that no rearrangement can cancel.
